assertions.name: alpha_is_degree_4_in_h
assertions.unit: |α₆|+|α₈| (must be 0: algebraic side is degree-4 in h)
assertions.source: alg multiplicative integral over 6 Q₈ crossings; order-6 full product is traceless ⇒ α₆=0

description: Empirical h⁶ test for conj:tau-all-orders-bridge. Computes the algebraic (Q₈ crossed-module) coefficients α_{2k} and the Markov-trace (Borromean Jones, skein h = q − q⁻¹) coefficients κ_{2k} for k=1..4. FINDING (negative/methodological): (i) α is DEGREE-4 in h (α₆=α₈=0 despite 6 crossings; the order-6 full product is traceless) while κ is infinite — a 2-vs-∞ structural asymmetry; (ii) at fixed q₀ both are constant sequences so a non-diagonal lower-triangular fit trivially solves the under-determined system, making the dichotomy's hypothesis (1) trivially true at the NUMBER level. The naive empirical fit is NON-DISCRIMINATING; the genuine open content needs a categorical naturality / banded-kernel constraint on T. Refines (does not resolve) conj:tau-all-orders-bridge.
